terms.gloss: keep away, hold back; keep oneself from, abstain (+ ablative, or ā)
evidence: Cic. Fam. 7.26: mē ostreīs et mūraenīs facile abstinēbam (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: aliēnō manum abstineat, sua servet dīligenter
phrases.english: let him keep his hands off what is another’s, and look carefully after his own

phrases.latin: mē ostreīs et mūraenīs facile abstinēbam
phrases.english: I easily kept off oysters and lampreys
